title.narrative: Capacity Building to Electricidade de Moçambique (EDM) & strategic studies - Monitoring and Evaluation (New)
Kapacitetsuppbyggnad till Electricidad de Moçambique(EDM) & strategiska studier

description.narrative:
Det övergripande målet med kapacitetsuppbyggnadsprogrammet är att göra det möjligt för EDM att bygga upp sin kapacitet inom områdena förbättrade kommersiella och finansiella resultat, intern ledning och kontroll samt en hållbar utveckling av företagets organisation och mänskliga resurser.
Förväntade resultat är: • Införande av International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) • Förbättrad ekonomisk hållbarhet • Minskat antal kvalifikationer i revisionsberättelser • Minskning av icke-tekniska förluster
Det övergripande målet med de strategiska studierna är att bidra till en förbättrad strategisk planering för en fortsatt ökad tillgång till säker energi och en allmän hållbar utveckling av sektorn.
Förväntade resultat är: • Utveckling av strategiska planer inom sektorn i linje med prioriteringarna i den svenska samarbetsstrategin med Moçambique, 2008-2012 • Utveckling eller up-dates av studier för identifiering av energiprojekt • Utveckling av förstudier för prioriterade projekt inom sektorn

The overall objective of the Capacity Building Program is to enable EDM to building up their capacity within the areas of improved commercial and financial performance, internal management and control and sustained development of the organisation and human resources of the company.
Expected results are: • Introduction of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) • Improved financial sustainability • Reduced number of qualifications in auditor’s reports • Reduction of non-technical losses
The overall objective of the Strategic Studies is to contribute to an improved strategic planning for a continued increase in access to secure energy and a general sustainable development of the sector.
Expected results are: • Development of strategic plans in the sector in line with priorities set in the Swedish Cooperation Strategy with Mozambique, 2008-2012 • Development or up-dates of studies for identification of energy projects • Development of feasibility studies for prioritized projects in the sector

The agreement which was signed in 2010 and has been amended six times due to the dynamics and necessities at EDM, has two key aspects, the capacity building component and the strategic studies component. The agreement period terminated on the 30th of June 2024 with the activity period ending on the 31st of December 2023. 1. Capacity building: the main objective of the Program is to provide sustainable energy for poverty reduction. The specific objectives are to enable EDM to provide sufficient, affordable and reliable electricity for the purpose of economic growth, improved delivery of public goods through improved capacity and to support strategic planning for a sustainable development of the energy sector. This (initial) CBP program had two separate but linked projects: Project A: Business and Process Development and Management, aiming to further develop EDM business areas and work processes to achieve improvements in the areas addressed, resulting in improved overall performance. Project B: Human Resources Development (HRD), to provide EDM staff with general and specific skills at various levels in a number of areas, including management. As the budget for Human Resources Development in Project B was primarily used to develop a training plan, the Embassy agreed to allocate additional funds for training activities for EDM staff focusing on two priority areas: 1) Procurement; and 2) Risk assessment in relation to Safety and Occupational Health and Environment. A further initiative as part of the transformation process with links to the CBP was the introduction of e-learning in the organization as an effective way to spread the Code of Ethics, adopted by the EDM Board in 2017, but also as a means to increase equal access to training opportunities in the organization and strengthen awareness of gender and environmental issues as a first step. The covid-19 pandemic also increased the necessity for e-learning since physical training was not possible. 2. Strategic Studies: the specific objective is to support strategic planning for sustainable development of the energy sector. The decision memorandum more specifically spells out the overall objective of the Strategic Studies to contribute to an improved strategic planning for a continued increase in access to secure energy and a general sustainable development of the sector. Expected results are: a) Development of strategic plans in the sector in line with priorities set in the Swedish Cooperation Strategy with Mozambique b) Development or up-dates of studies for identification of energy projects c) Development of feasibility studies for prioritized projects in the sector

tag.narrative: 7.1 - By 2030, ensure universal access to affordable, reliable and modern energy services.
7.1 - Senast 2030 säkerställa allmän tillgång till ekonomiskt överkomliga, tillförlitliga och moderna energitjänster.
7.2 - By 2030, increase substantially the share of renewable energy in the global energy mix.
7.2 - Till 2030 väsentligen öka andelen förnybar energi i den globala energimixen.

7.b - By 2030, expand infrastructure and upgrade technology for supplying modern and sustainable energy services for all in developing countries, in particular least developed countries, small island developing States and landlocked developing countries, in accordance with their respective programmes of support.

7.b - Till 2030 bygga ut infrastrukturen och uppgradera tekniken för att leverera moderna och hållbara energitjänster till alla i utvecklingsländerna, i synnerhet de minst utvecklade länderna och små önationer under utveckling.
